patthana22.15:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na akusalaṃ na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na abyākataṃ na sauttaraṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato sauttaro dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. pañca, na kusalaṃ na saraṇaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
